name: Erika Barkhausen
source: Erika Barkhausen is a 23-year-old German corporal. She hails from a family of farmers from the Rhineland. Although not a particularly well-educated person, she sometimes displays a kind of rustic peasant wisdom which makes up for her lack of higher learning.
